subject: reasoning
question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6d0369af3d38674250704eb6d34dc72839b4e0cca1ad115b56e3e95df4ff257.png]
solution: The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below: 1) Number of triangles = [Number of parts x (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = Total triangles = [2 x (1 + 2)] ÷ 2 = [2 x 3] ÷ 2 = 6 ÷ 2 = 3
